notes.title: Demo is out, and some changes
notes.notes:
Some of you have already given us feedback, thank you very much! We've taken your comments into account and made a few modifications and corrections to improve your experience.

[b]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: hard lock when talking to Roy at the begining of mission #2
[*] SteamVR has been removed from the startup process
[*] Fixed: The "Remaining Barrels" task now accurately updates when rounding down.
[*] Fixed: The "Full!" message no longer appears during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed: Added a fail safe on [spoiler] Elodie when the metal doors need to be removed in the sewers[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed: more robust quest saving system
[*] Fixed: The garbage pile is restored [spoiler]when the sewer[/spoiler] mission is replayed from the beginning
[*] Fixed: removed constraint when Player tries to go to bed at 3 a.m
[/list]

[b]🍳 Story & Gameplay Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*]  [spoiler]The dog's fate has been changed[/spoiler]
[*] Bandages now provide better health recovery when applied
[/list]

[b]📚 Tutorials & Guidance[/b]
[list]
[*] Addition of a tutorial showing that it is now possible to cook sandwiches to restore energy
[*] Added a reminder tutorial if you forget your backpack when waking up.
[*] A quick bandage usage reminder has been added during the mission [spoiler] in the sewers [/spoiler].
[*] Added a reminder to return to bed at the end of the day at the start of the game
[/list]

[b]🎮 Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced difficulty in the [spoiler]fast-food section[/spoiler]: introduced a fail-safe: if you retry a checkpoint more than once, the challenge will ease up.
[/list]

What's next?
Continue to collect your feedback
Multiplayer study: feel free to take part in the discussions

Thank you!

Dazarious
